title: Meh. Okay if money/value not a factor.
text: Two small packages of jerky. Maybe better than gas station, but no different from grocery except several times more expensive. I ate the two packages I got. They were nothing special and certainly not the best I've tasted. Maybe fun to receive, but if money/value is a factor in your decision, I would pass. Plus: they get an extra star for including cancellation instructions with the order.
label: neutral
